user_prompt: We need to pull together a comprehensive view of our production risks and costs right now - I want to see both our material expenses broken down by supplier along with any compliance gaps, and at the same time analyze our recent safety incidents and trends across all our manufacturing sites. Can you get me both of those datasets so we can address cost optimization and safety improvements in our next operations review?

steps.step_name: Show me our material expenses broken down by supplier and identify any compliance gaps in our production operations

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY FINDINGS BY FUNCTION:
- STAFFING & CAPABILITY ANALYSIS: sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1
- CAMPAIGN SAFETY & ENGAGEMENT: emarsys.cx:agent:IncidentComplianceOrchestrator:v1
- PAYROLL & COMPENSATION: sap.sf:apiResource:EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1
- PRODUCT ECONOMICS: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1
- PRODUCTION SCHEDULES: my.mes:apiResource:EquipmentOEEAnalytics:v1

VENDOR SAFETY COMPLIANCE & PROCUREMENT:
- VENDOR SAFETY VERIFICATION: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1
- HAZARD TRACKING (supplier): sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1

MATERIAL EXPENSES & SUPPLIER COMPLIANCE:
- INVOICE RECONCILIATION: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
  * Three-way matching of vendor invoices to POs & contracts
  * Flags overbilling, duplicates, policy violations
  * Note: Focused on reconciliation, not expense breakdown analytics
  
- SUPPLIER QUALITY & COMPLIANCE MONITORING: my.mes:agent:SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator:v1
  * Monitors supplier quality metrics & vendor compliance status
  * Coordinates across purchase orders and contracts (material expense visibility)
  * Processes incoming material inspections & escalates non-conformance
  * Orchestrates quality certifications & supplier audit schedules
  * Best match for: "material expenses broken down by supplier + compliance gaps in production"

PART SPECS vs SUPPLIER CERTIFICATIONS:
- PART SPECS vs SUPPLIER CERTIFICATIONS: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1
- PRODUCTION BOM COMPLIANCE: my.mes:agent:BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator:v1

args.reason: Automates vendor performance monitoring and procurement compliance validation by coordinating material expenses across POs/contracts while identifying non-conformance and compliance gaps in production operations.

method_trace.picked_reason: Automates vendor performance monitoring and procurement compliance validation by coordinating material expenses across POs/contracts while identifying non-conformance and compliance gaps in production operations.
